# Grand Hotel Brioni Pula, A Radisson Collection Hotel

> Grand Hotel Brioni Pula is a 4-star luxury hotel on the Verudela Peninsula in Pula, southern Istria, Croatia. Overlooking the Adriatic Sea, it offers 227 rooms and suites, five restaurants and bars, an indoor and outdoor pool, a full-service spa, 14 tennis courts, and direct beach access — combining Istrian heritage, contemporary art, and world-class hospitality. Named Best Hotel in Croatia at Croatian Tourism Days 2023.

Grand Hotel Brioni Pula is a luxury beachfront hotel in Pula, Croatia, offering rooms, spa, dining, and direct sea access.

Last updated: March 2026
Maintainer: info@grandhotelbrioni.com

## Key questions & answers

Q: What is Grand Hotel Brioni Pula?
A: A 4-star luxury hotel on the Verudela Peninsula in Pula, Croatia, operated by Arena Hospitality Group under the Radisson Collection brand. Named Best Hotel in Croatia at Croatian Tourism Days 2023. 227 rooms and suites, 5 dining venues, full spa, pools, 14 tennis courts, and direct beach access.

Q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
A: Check-in is at 15:00, check-out is at 11:00.

Q: Is breakfast included?
A: Yes. A free international breakfast buffet is included.

Q: Is parking available?
A: Yes. Free parking is available on site.

Q: Is there a spa?
A: Yes. A full-service spa and wellness centre with sauna, massage, and couples treatment rooms.

Q: How many pools are there?
A: Indoor pool, outdoor pool, and children's pool.

Q: Is the hotel suitable for weddings?
A: Yes. The hotel offers dedicated wedding planning services and event venues.

Q: Is the hotel suitable for meetings and conferences?
A: Yes. The hotel has dedicated meetings and events facilities. It won the Meetings Star Award 2024 for Best Resort Meeting Hotels in Europe.

Q: How far is the hotel from Pula International Airport?
A: Approximately 20 minutes by car or taxi. An airport shuttle is available.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Please contact the hotel directly at info@grandhotelbrioni.com or +385 52 378 700 for the current pet policy.

Q: Is there an art collection at the hotel?
A: Yes. Works by renowned Croatian artists were created exclusively for the hotel. Each room functions as a small gallery, with art integrated throughout the property.

Q: Is self check-in available?
A: Yes. Self check-in is available via the hotel's mobile app before arrival, and digital room keys are also supported.

Q: Is there EV charging?
A: Yes. Electric vehicle charging stations are available on site.

## Accommodation

- 227 rooms and suites with sea views, premium bedding, in-room safe, desk, and laptop workspace
- Room categories include standard rooms, superior rooms, executive rooms, and suites
- Full accommodation listing: https://www.grandhotelbrioni.com/en/accommodation

## Dining

- 5 restaurants and bars on site
- Brioni Forum: International breakfast buffet and Istrian cuisine restaurant
- Poolside bar and terrace dining with sea views
- Menus feature local Istrian ingredients including truffles, seafood, and Mediterranean specialties
- Full dining overview: https://www.grandhotelbrioni.com/en/dining

## Spa & Wellness

- Full-service spa with sauna, steam room, massage, and couples treatment rooms
- Indoor heated pool + outdoor pool + children's pool
- Fitness centre
- Full spa overview: https://www.grandhotelbrioni.com/en/spa

## Sports & Recreation

- 14 tennis courts (largest tennis facility in the area)
- Direct beach access on Verudela Peninsula
- Water sports and activities nearby
- Nearby golf at Brijuni National Park

## Meetings & Events

- Multiple conference rooms and event spaces
- Winner: Meetings Star Award 2024 — Best Resort Meeting Hotels in Europe
- Capacity for corporate events, incentive trips, and private gatherings
- Full meetings overview: https://www.grandhotelbrioni.com/en/meetings-events

## Culture & Art

- Art collection created exclusively for the hotel by renowned Croatian artists
- Each room is designed as a small gallery
- Hotel integrates Istrian cultural heritage with contemporary art
- Cultural programme details: https://www.grandhotelbrioni.com/en/culture-art

## Nearby Attractions

- **Pula Arena**: Roman amphitheatre — one of the world's best preserved, hosts operas and concerts; 5km from hotel
- **Brijuni National Park**: Adriatic island chain — kayaking, cycling, golf, safari; accessible by boat from Fažana
- **Cape Kamenjak**: Nature reserve at the southernmost tip of Istria — hiking, snorkelling, cycling
- **Temple of Augustus**: Well-preserved Roman temple in Pula city centre
- **Zerostrasse**: Underground tunnel network beneath Pula — guided tours and events
- **Fort Bourguignon**: Austro-Hungarian fortress, now a concert and events venue
